summary: All 12 selected items are within the 7-12 target with a healthy spread across news, analysis, and practitioner categories, and each traces to a named author, institution, or first-party account, so the full set is kept with no replacements. Two set-level caveats are flagged. First, the Karpathy LLM UI/UX framing (item_2069547676849557725) and the SlackHQ Claude Tag launch (item_2069470647470977288) cover the same Slack-Claude-integration story from distinct angles (practitioner analysis vs first-party product announcement); both are retained as complementary, and the Karpathy reserve follow-up was correctly left in reserve to avoid a third restatement and author overrepresentation. Second, the synthwavedd release-schedule scoop (item_2069432791184650426) is a single anonymous multi-claim rumor with no primary-source link; it is high-signal (1.2M views) so it is retained but flagged for source traceability. IntCyberDigest appears twice but on two genuinely distinct stories (Meta tracking halt and the Tolmo kernel transcript), which is acceptable. No additional Twitter searches are required.
